description: A grid whose every cell is itself a grid: two levels of cell group, not one crossed grid. Both levels facet by row, which is what pins the heading rule — `parseFacetHeader` folds the inner level's caption into the outer one's and nulls the inner, so the rows are captioned once, at the top, as `region / size`. It also pins the band: a header naming another grid cannot be as tall as what it names, there being no one cell to match, so it takes `headerBand` and is centred on it instead.
